name: h5ad-shiny-data-pipeline
description: Patterns for building H5AD-backed data pipelines for Shiny apps with Excel fallback. Trigger: (1) replacing Excel data loading with H5AD in Shiny, (2) storing tabular groovy/TSV data in AnnData .uns for R consumption, (3) scVI batch correction validation with silhouette/LISI metrics, (4) rebuilding trajectory from fixed aggregation pipeline. Verified on R 4.x, Shiny 1.12.1, anndata (R), scanpy 1.11.5, scvi-tools 1.4.0.
